Help the ghosts of [[Barris Lefey|Barris]] and [[Tamra Lefey]] find their peace by assuring them that their son [[Toby Lefey]] is safe.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Find the ghosts of [[Barris Lefey|Barris]] and [[Tamra Lefey]].
* Lead the ghosts to the gates of Ascalon City.
* See [[Elise Lefey]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
[[Emote|Kneel]] at the [[statue of Dwayna]] in [[Sardelac Sanitarium]]. The [[Avatar of Dwayna (NPC)|Avatar of Dwayna]] will appear with a quest marker over her head. Speak with her to get the quest.

This quest is easiest to do if you leave from [[Ascalon City]]. Head west and keep along with the Wall, and continue to hug the wall. You'll fight some [[Gargoyle]]s and [[Hulking Stone Elemental]]s while hugging the walls. You'll pass [[Master Ranger Nente]] and a collector at the [[statue of Balthazar]] (the former entrance to [[Green Hills County]] in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]]). Continue heading west, and you'll encounter some [[Devourer]]s that pop out of the ground. Once the hills break, veer southwest (the exit to the Breach will be to the northwest). You'll have to clear any enemies surrounding the ghosts before they'll follow you, but approach the ghosts and they'll speak (point A on the wiki map).

Head back east once you've found the ghosts. It should be an easy walk back, but you may encounter some stray Hulking Stone Elementals. You'll lead the ghosts back down near the clearing between [[Ambassador Zain]]'s caravan and [[Warmaster Grast]] (point B). Elise and [[Toby Lefey]] will run down from the broken wall, and another dialogue will ensue between the ghosts, later joined by Elise and Toby. The ghosts disappear when the dialogue is finished, and you can speak with Elise to get your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Avatar of Dwayna
:''"So much have the people of Ascalon suffered. Though you do not see them, many ghosts wander these desolate lands, unable to accept what has befallen them and move on. Dwayna wishes you to bring peace to two such tortured souls. Go into '''Old Ascalon''' and find the ghosts of '''Barris and Tamra Lefey'''. Lead them to the gates of '''Ascalon City''' and wait there."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am Dwayna's servant.
| decline = I am not worthy of this task.
| ask = If you are here, then the spirits of '''Barris and Tamra Lefey''' are still in torment. Do not linger when Dwayna has offered you such a noble purpose. Go into '''Old Ascalon''' and lead those spirits to the gates of Ascalon City. There shall they find some measure of peace.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
Approaching the ghosts:
:'''Tamra Lefey''': ''Have you seen our son? Have you seen our Toby?''
:'''Barris Lefey''': ''Perhaps [[Grenth]] has taken him already.''
:'''Tamra Lefey''': ''What hope would an orphan have in a place like this?''
:'''Barris Lefey''': ''We should be there to protect him, but we have failed.''

Outside Ascalon City:
:'''Elise Lefey''': ''Don't wander too far, Toby. It can be dangerous out here.''
:'''Elise Lefey''': ''Are you doing okay, Toby? I don't know why, but...I just woke up with the feeling that it was time... Time to come take a look out here.''
:'''Toby Lefey''': ''Yes, Aunt Elise.''

:'''Barris Lefey''': ''Do you remember this spot, Tamra?''
:'''Tamra Lefey''': ''Of course. Toby loved the field that...that used to be here.''
:'''Barris Lefey''': ''It seems so long ago. The ground is so barren now.''

:'''Toby Lefey''': ''Mother, is that you?''
:'''Tamra Lefey''': ''Toby, you're alive!''
:'''Barris Lefey''': ''You look well, my boy. Is someone...''
:'''Toby Lefey''': ''Aunt Elise!''
:'''Barris Lefey''': ''We have felt Grenth's call, but we worried for you so...''
:'''Barris Lefey''': ''We have searched for you every day.''
:'''Elise Lefey''': ''He is safe, Barris. I won't let anything bad happen to him. No matter what.''
:'''Barris Lefey''': ''I can see that, Elise. We know you'll take good care of him.''
:'''Tamra Lefey''': ''We love you both. Never forget that.''
:'''Toby Lefey''': ''I love you, too.''

===Reward dialogue===
;Elise Lefey
:''"Thank you. I do not know how you knew to bring them here, but I thank you. It means so much for Toby to see his mother and father one last time. And maybe it means even more for them."''

:''"It seems their spirits have been wandering all this time in anguish, wondering what happened to little Toby, here. But now they know I made it, and that I'll take care of him. They'd be so proud of Toby, I tell you. He's growing into a fine young man. A right proper, fine young man."''
